summary: Halyard template mutual NDA with Veridian Cloud, Inc. whose edits are mostly US spellings and entity details, plus an added contractors category, a request to cut survival to 2 years and a request for Delaware or New York law.

findings.quote: (2) [[INS: VERIDIAN CLOUD, INC.]], a company incorporated
findings.why: The counterparty entity details (Delaware company, San Francisco address, company number deleted) were changed and need checking against the company register.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Thank you for the corrected entity details; we will confirm them against the company register.

findings.quote: the Receiving Party undertakes to the Disclosing Party that it shall:
findings.why: Obligations bind the Receiving Party and Disclosing Party and Receiving Party are defined so either Party can be either.

findings.quote: which is either marked or identified as confidential at the time of disclosure or would reasonably be considered confidential given the nature of the information
findings.why: Definition covers information disclosed for the Purpose that is marked or reasonably confidential and includes derived notes and analyses.

findings.quote: not use or exploit the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in any way except solely for the Purpose;
findings.why: Use is limited solely to the Purpose, which is discussions about a potential commercial relationship.

findings.quote: which the Receiving Party can demonstrate by written records or other reasonable evidence:
findings.why: All four carve-outs (public domain, already held, third party, independent development) are present and unnarrowed.

findings.quote: [[INS: independent contractors,]]
findings.why: The insertion adds independent contractors to Representatives, a category outside the playbook's list of permitted recipients, widening who may receive Confidential Information.
findings.draft_redline: Representatives means, in relation to a Party, the employees, officers, directors, professional advisers, auditors and insurers of that Party and of any member of its Group.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We would prefer to keep Representatives to employees, officers, directors, advisers, auditors and insurers; contractors needing access can be agreed case by case.

findings.quote: who strictly need to know such Confidential Information in order to evaluate or further the Purpose
findings.why: Disclosure to Representatives and Group members is need-to-know and the Receiving Party stays liable for them.

findings.quote: to the extent that it is legally permitted to do so:
findings.why: Compelled disclosure is permitted, notice is only where legally permitted, and resisting disclosure is at the Disclosing Party's cost.

findings.quote: within ten Business Days of receipt of such request:
findings.why: Ten Business Days, officer-signed confirmation and a carve-out for backups and legally required copies that stay confidential.

findings.quote: shall remain the exclusive property of the Disclosing Party (or its licensors, as applicable).
findings.why: IP stays with the Disclosing Party and no licence is granted beyond use for the Purpose.

findings.quote: Neither Party makes any representation or gives any warranty, express or implied, as to the accuracy
findings.why: Information is as is, mutual no-warranty, fraud carve-out preserved and no obligation to proceed.

findings.quote: without the prior written consent of the other Party, except as required by law
findings.why: Mutual publicity restriction requiring prior written consent.

findings.quote: that Party shall not disclose such personal data unless and until the Parties have agreed and entered into a separate written data processing agreement
findings.why: Only business contact details are anticipated and any other personal data needs a separate DPA first.

findings.quote: for a period of two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party giving not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice
findings.why: Two-year term with 30 days' notice to terminate early, matching the preferred position.

findings.quote: for a period of three (3) years from the effective date of expiry or termination
findings.why: Three-year survival with Trade Secrets protected while they remain so matches the preferred position; the counterparty comment asks for 2 years, which the playbook allows if Trade Secret protection is kept.

findings.quote: a Party shall be entitled to seek the remedies of injunction, specific performance and other equitable relief
findings.why: Mutual right to seek equitable relief and remedies are cumulative under 11.2.

findings.quote: not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble or otherwise attempt to derive the composition
findings.why: Reverse engineering of software and prototypes is prohibited.

findings.quote: shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England and Wales.
findings.why: Clause text is English law as preferred; the comment asks for Delaware or New York law, which must be declined with an English law offer or escalated.

findings.quote: the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction
findings.why: Exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales as preferred.

findings.quote: without the prior written consent of the other Party.
findings.why: Mutual no assignment without prior written consent.

findings.quote: [[INS: (such as DocuSign or Adobe Sign)]]
findings.why: The insertion only gives examples of e-signature platforms in an existing counterparts and e-signature clause.
